narr: Thunderstorms produced locally heavy rain in northern New Jersey from the late afternoon into the nighttime hours of June 26. Rainfall totals were as high as 2 to 5 inches.
ev: Minor flooding occurred along the Whippany River in Hanover Township, Morris Township and Morristown.
NJ Route 57 in Franklin Township was closed due to flooding west of Warren County Route 643.
Pleasant Run Road in Readington Township was closed due to flooding between Hunterdon County Route 523 and Cole Road.
US Route 22 westbound in Readington Township was closed due to flooding near Potterstown Road.
NJ Route 173 in Greenwich Township was closed due to flooding west of South Main Street and Maple Drive.
US Route 206 in Andover Township was closed due to flooding near Goodale Road.
Flooding occurred on US Route 46 in Dover with sections of the roadway becoming impassable. A vehicle was stranded on NJ Route 10 in Randolph Township.
lsr: The Whippany River gauge at Morristown crested in minor flood stage at 6.05 feet.
Report of vehicles stranded on Route 10 in Morris County, NJ. Time given in report.
The Whippany River gauge at Morristown reached minor flood stage of 6.01 feet.
